from pathlib import Path
prog_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
prog_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # A horizontal stripe that changes into the surrounding field at its right end
    # marks that terminal field segment; recolor it as the encoded accent (1).
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if not row:
            continue
        first = row[0]
        end = 1
        while end < len(row) and row[end] == first:
            end += 1
        if end < len(row):
            # Only treat a suffix as the marked continuation, not an internal change.
            if all(v == row[end] for v in row[end:]):
                out[r][end:] = [1] * (len(row) - end)
    return out
'''
p=prog_dir/'task-8bbc356b.py'; p.write_text(source)
# validate demo
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
demo_in=[[4]*20 for _ in range(14)]; demo_in[2]=[8]*20; demo_in[9]=[8]*16+[4]*4
demo_out=transform(demo_in)
print(demo_out[9], demo_out[2], all(demo_out[r]==demo_in[r] for r in range(14) if r!=9 and r!=2))
